set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)

set(ENABLE_MBEDTLS OFF)
set(ENABLE_NETTLE OFF)
set(ENABLE_OPENSSL OFF)

set(ENABLE_LIBB2 OFF)
set(ENABLE_LZ4 OFF)
set(ENABLE_LZO OFF)
set(ENABLE_LZMA ON)
set(ENABLE_ZSTD OFF)
set(ENABLE_ZLIB OFF)
set(ENABLE_BZip2 OFF)

set(ENABLE_CPIO OFF)
set(ENABLE_CPIO_SHARED OFF)
set(ENABLE_CAT OFF)
set(ENABLE_CAT_SHARED OFF)
set(ENABLE_UNZIP OFF)
set(ENABLE_UNZIP_SHARED OFF)

set(ENABLE_TEST OFF)
set(ENABLE_INSTALL OFF)

if(LibLZMA_TYPE STREQUAL Bundled)
  set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_LibLZMA TRUE)
  set(LIBLZMA_FOUND TRUE)
  set(LIBLZMA_LIBRARIES LibLZMA::LibLZMA)
  get_target_property(LIBLZMA_INCLUDE_DIRS ${LIBLZMA_LIBRARIES} INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
endif()

add_subdirectory(libarchive)
dolphin_disable_warnings(archive_static)
add_library(LibArchive::LibArchive ALIAS archive_static)
